name: DonutShop v0.7.25
body:
**Files**
- Same directory copy is now supported.
  - Example: "N64.rt4" would be "N64 copy.rt4", the next copy would be "N64 copy 2.rt4", etc. This mirrors the way macOS handles same directory copies.
- [clear] button is now [unselect] and # of files selected joins the button so its function is obvious. 
- Linux now represented in Files -> Notes for bulk copy selection operations. 
  - Cmd-click for macOS, Ctrl-click for all other Desktop OS.

**Misc**
- Cleaned up top bar button press and popover handling
- 3 second status poll no longer shows in Console when updating. reduces clutter.

**RESTful API beta**
- GET /api/info | Device and firmware information
- GET /api/status | Current RetroTink and DonutShop status
- POST /api/command | Send a RetroTink serial command
- GET /api/files/ | List the SD card root
- GET /api/files/<path> | List a directory or download a file
- PUT /api/files/<path> | Create or overwrite a file
- DELETE /api/files/<path> | Delete a file or empty folder
- POST /api/files/mkdir | Create a folder
- POST /api/files/move | Move or rename a file or folder
- Additional info/status fields very likely
- Documentation still being worked on, but the framework is in place to tinker with for now...
